rows.text: Independent storage review required exact recomputation of staged documents, original/staged metadata hashes, and persisted evidence verification. Converter now checks all three and validates every generation with production owner rules.

Boundary reviewer approved the verified five-store cutover: 617/3/4/4/1 committed generations, identical revision sets and CURRENT pointers, 222 immutable evidence artifacts, no unresolved queue exits. Swapped stores and restarted the actual service; live read at revision 618 succeeds. Final tests and live inspection still in progress.
